limitations: This is a 60-second development-host quick baseline, not the required 300-second final T15 measurement.
The webcam scene produced no usable garment mask, so optical-flow, color, risk, and recolor timings were unavailable in the live baseline.
The observed +0.54 percent FPS difference between sequential runs is consistent with low overhead but is not a calibrated overhead bound because webcam workload and host scheduling can vary.
SCHP inference runs on a worker thread and overlaps the main loop; stage durations must not be summed as serial loop time.
The three-frame synchronous video run only verifies stage wiring and cannot be used as a stable performance estimate.
notes: Instrumentation identifies SCHP inference as the longest individual worker operation, while white balance and presentation dominate the measured main thread in the mask-empty webcam scene. No optimization was performed.
